record_format: A row contains status, local address or idle, raw and displayed words, and optional tag. Slots set a preallocated local address bank to 101 on every offered address except the supplied holder, where it is 011. A pre-setting herald is present on each transcript. Each completed write fills a fresh ready bank, preserving all older banks and their receipts. The preset end mark occurs at the same slot on all branches, including idle, with no far-triggered tick. A calibration bit for each address is the fixed indicator of its named reversed occurrence. An unused or coherently cleared tag bank stays at 110. An ignored tag is present in physical storage exactly as in the corresponding held-tag panel, then omitted from the observed law. Literal trials obtain the local records through a central communication step. That evaluator's eligibility, random choice and joint trace are absent from the local record. In those trials the completed-detection field means delivery of the selected ordinary word and the raw-holder fields describe that received word, with no separate coherent pointer interaction.
denominator_format: For each distribution the integer numerator is the last entry of a row. Its denominator is stated once. A missing row has zero mass. An absent accepted-source distribution is null.
conditional_history_and_privacy: To recover the conditional law from any launch history, restrict it to the ready herald and divide by the displayed source acceptance. For no ready herald it is undefined. Proof of privacy uses the complete local instruments (including the idle identity and refusal), with each opposite-wing policy's branch-summed operation trace preserving. An adaptive choice is a local channel controlled only by that wing's previous local record. Consequently no finite adaptive tree changes the nonselective local transcript law when the other wing's policy is changed.
dephased_and_direct_source_history_repla: All accepted branches here are diagonal. Reading a history is multiplication by indicators of observed local words. Thus the coherent and dephased accepted-state histories coincide exactly. For direct preparation from accepted ordinary words, use that same conditional law at launch with acceptance one.
